title: App showcase gets fresher data
summary:
A housekeeping day: fresher app listings, cleaner contributor links, and less legacy code in the image API.

The automated catalog update refreshed app metrics, health checks, and showcase links, and corrected the credit for Pollinations Avatar Gen - Reforged.

The Latest News and Recent Apps sections were updated with contributor profiles in place of placeholder author links, while invalid links were removed from two app names.

The unused `/feed` SSE endpoint and its event-publishing code were removed from the image API. Image generation no longer builds feed payloads; `nofeed` and `private` remain accepted but no longer affect feed publishing.
